These probabilities are priors from general knowledge of NAS-Bench-201 behavior, not from querying the benchmark. Most interactions are small, so N dominates. I raised H or L where one op plausibly substitutes for or compounds with another. Examples are redundant parallel conv paths, a conv edge being more valuable when the alternate paths are none, and the parent edge being the same as the edited edge.
